# Research Summary Template

```markdown
# Research: [Topic]
**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Requested by:** [name or cron job]
**Model used:** [Flash/Pro/Sonnet/Opus]
**Sources checked:** [count]

## TL;DR
[2-3 sentence summary of findings]

## Key Findings
1. [Finding with source]
2. [Finding with source]
3. [Finding with source]

## Data / Evidence
| Metric | Value | Source |
|--------|-------|--------|
| | | |

## Gaps / Unknowns
- [What couldn't be verified]
- [What needs deeper investigation]

## Recommendations
1. [Actionable recommendation]
2. [Actionable recommendation]

## Sources
- [URL or document reference with date accessed]
```

## Usage Notes
- Save to docs/research/[topic-slug]-YYYY-MM-DD.md
- Always include date checked and source notes
- Flag if sources are >30 days old at time of use
